title: Busy-Polling for State Transitions
pattern: Spinning in a loop repeatedly checking an event source or state variable without yielding to the scheduler or OS reactor.
why_bad: Burns 100% CPU on the polling thread, starving other processes and wasting massive system resources.
detection: An active loop containing non-blocking state checks without sleeps, yields, or waker registrations.
counterexample: Yielding spinlocks used under extremely low-latency, controlled scheduling contexts.
